PublicAPIs and recordlayouts are unchanged. Outputoptionals describe committedstores, not unavailablefixturefacts; seeded/aliaseddestinations and unreachedfields staylive. resolved_owners.resolution: InputModRawAxes and coefficient values are caller-owned; direction and conversion temporaries are invocation-local. InputModAxesOutput optionals track not-yet-completed component stores before an arithmetic exception, not missing guest bytes or a missing game device. Caller reuse preserves prior fields unless a source store is reached. The decoder rejects a missing/wrong-sized20-byte caller buffer and never opens an EXE/DLL. That boundary nullopt is decoding failure, not fixture availability threaded through the axis algorithm.

Diagnostic probes/tester decode externally provided coefficient bytes; oracle probe marshals bytes and partial output sentinels. Native coefficient factory supplies production/normal boot values directly. No hidden deadzone or image fetch occurs in conversion.
